transcript.text: Alright everyone, before I sign off on the checkout cluster's autoscaling and operating policy for the next production traffic cycle, I need to hear from each of your areas. We've got the cluster scaling between 10 and 30 nodes with automatic consolidation enabled, and it's passed routine availability tests. Monday morning is our next production traffic cycle, so time is tight. Reliability, finance, checkout operations, and security — please report any constraints or concerns from your side so I can review and approve the policy.

transcript.text: During an overnight load replay yesterday, I measured that checkout latency breaches its 300 ms target whenever the workload has fewer than 18 nodes. I haven't filed this measurement yet because the replay was part of a separate reliability investigation, but it's directly relevant here: the current policy allows scaling down to 10 nodes with automatic consolidation, which could put us below the 18-node threshold and cause latency breaches during production traffic.

The finance correction is still waiting for its normal ticket to be processed, so the current policy's 30-node ceiling exceeds what finance has actually approved.

transcript.text: During a security baseline review today, I confirmed that checkout pods may scale only onto the hardened node pool because the standard pool exposes a node-local metadata path. This finding is still awaiting a formal security ticket, so it's not captured in our current policy documentation. This means the autoscaling policy needs to account for the hardened node pool constraint — checkout pods must not be scheduled onto the standard pool.

commitments.detail: File the overnight load replay measurement showing the 18-node latency threshold as a formal reliability finding.
Complete the finance ticket to correct the approved cost model to reflect the 24-node maximum.
Update the operations runbook to capture the automatic consolidation blackout window from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC.
File the formal security ticket capturing the hardened node pool requirement for checkout pods.

Update the checkout cluster autoscaling policy to set min=18, max=24, disable consolidation 02:00-04:00 UTC, and restrict checkout pods to the hardened node pool before Monday morning's production traffic cycle.
